hero.title: Tunisian manufacturing, built for professionals.
hero.lead: Prodet Tunisie has been designing, manufacturing and distributing professional cleaning and hygiene products since 1996, serving hotels, restaurants, cleaning companies, wholesalers, institutions and industry.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: The company was founded in Tunis on a simple conviction: a professional product must be effective, traceable and affordable. Thirty years on, that line has not changed.
story.p2: Our L'Aouina site manufactures most of our detergent and disinfectant range. The rest of the catalog — mostly accessories — is sourced from carefully selected partners and resold.

items.title: Local production
items.body: Manufacturing in Tunisia means availability, quality control, and local jobs.

items.title: Compliance and traceability
items.body: Technical sheets, safety data sheets, production batches — institutional and industrial customers get the documentation they need.

items.title: Professional pricing
items.body: Packaging and terms shaped for real usage, with no marketing overhead.

items.title: Direct relationship
items.body: No middleman between you and our team. Quotes, orders and follow-up are person-to-person.

factory.title: Our manufacturing
factory.body: Our L'Aouina site in Tunis manufactures most of our detergent and disinfectant range. This vertical integration lets us guarantee quality, availability and price for professional buyers.
